blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In the rivers and wetlands of Barangay Sta. Filomena in Calanasan, Apayao, hundreds of birds have found a refuge, including species threatened with extinction and others found nowhere else in the world but the Philippines. A three-day wildlife survey conducted by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Cordillera Administrative Region recorded 427 birds belonging to 23 species. Among the birds documented were the endangered rufous hornbill (Buceros hydrocorax), vulnerable Luzon hornbill (Penelopides manillae) and vulnerable Philippine duck (Anas luzonica).
